might.label: Might
might.description: Increases weapon & skill damage (+1%/pt), Crit Multiplier (+0.5%/pt), and Armor Break (+0.4%/pt).

agility.label: Agility
agility.description: Increases Attack Speed (+0.4%/pt), Double-Hit Chance, DoT Tick Speed (+0.67%/pt), and Dodge Rating (+0.5/pt).

wisdom.label: Wisdom
wisdom.description: Increases Cast Speed (+0.4%/pt), Max Mana (+1.5/pt) & Regen (+0.25/s/pt), Max Ward (+1.2/pt), and Ailment Potency.

fortitude.label: Fortitude
fortitude.description: Increases Max Health (+3/pt), Health Regen (+0.15/s/pt), Armor (+1.5/pt), and Thorns (+0.4/pt).

max_hp.label: Max Health
max_hp.description: Total life pool before the Soul-Spark shatters. Scaled by Fortitude and +10 per level.

max_mana.label: Max Mana
max_mana.description: Resource spent by active skills. Base 100 (+5 per level, +1.5 per Wisdom) minus aura reservations.

max_ward.label: Max Ward
max_ward.description: Recharging barrier absorbing post-mitigation hits before Health. Recharges at 20%/s after 2s without damage.

hp_regen.label: Health Regen /s
hp_regen.description: Health restored passively every second, scaled by Fortitude.

mana_regen.label: Mana Regen /s
mana_regen.description: Mana restored every second (12 base + Wisdom scaling), supplemented by +4 Mana per weapon hit.

armor.label: Armor
armor.description: Reduces incoming physical and hit damage up to 80% based on attacker level.

armor_break.label: Armor Break %
armor_break.description: Percentage of enemy Armor ignored by your physical hits, scaled by Might.

dodge_rating.label: Dodge Rating
dodge_rating.description: Feeds entropy-assisted evasion. Accumulates per incoming hit and dodges when reaching 100.

thorns.label: Thorns
thorns.description: Reflects physical damage back to any enemy that strikes you.

crit_chance.label: Crit Chance %
crit_chance.description: Probability that weapon hits and offensive skills deal Critical Strike damage.

crit_multi.label: Crit Multiplier %
crit_multi.description: Bonus damage added to Critical Strikes on top of the 150% baseline and Might bonus.

attack_speed.label: Attack Speed %
attack_speed.description: Accelerates weapon auto-attacks and attack skills, reducing post-cast recovery.

weapon_min.label: Weapon Min Damage
weapon_min.description: Flat minimum physical damage added to weapon auto-attacks.

weapon_max.label: Weapon Max Damage
weapon_max.description: Flat maximum physical damage added to weapon auto-attacks.

ailment_potency.label: Ailment Potency %
ailment_potency.description: Amplifies damage and debuff strength of Bleed, Ignite, Chill, Shock, and Corruption.

dot_speed.label: DoT Tick Speed %
dot_speed.description: Accelerates how rapidly Bleed, Ignite, and Corruption deal damage over time.

res_fire.label: Fire Resistance %
res_fire.description: Mitigates incoming Fire hits with soft-punishment scaling up to 75%.

res_frost.label: Frost Resistance %
res_frost.description: Mitigates incoming Frost hits with soft-punishment scaling up to 75%.

res_lightning.label: Lightning Resistance %
res_lightning.description: Mitigates incoming Lightning hits with soft-punishment scaling up to 75%.

res_void.label: Void Resistance %
res_void.description: Mitigates incoming Void hits with soft-punishment scaling up to 75%.

res_physical.label: Physical Resistance %
res_physical.description: Additional flat percentage mitigation against Physical hits.

dmg_physical.label: Physical Damage %
dmg_physical.description: Increases all Physical hit and Bleed damage dealt.

dmg_fire.label: Fire Damage %
dmg_fire.description: Increases all Fire hit and Ignite damage dealt.

dmg_frost.label: Frost Damage %
dmg_frost.description: Increases all Frost hit and Chill damage dealt.

dmg_lightning.label: Lightning Damage %
dmg_lightning.description: Increases all Lightning hit and Shock effect strength.

dmg_void.label: Void Damage %
dmg_void.description: Increases all Void hit and Corruption damage dealt.

dmg_increased.label: Increased Damage %
dmg_increased.description: Global additive damage multiplier applied across all weapon hits and skills.

dot_multiplier.label: DoT Multiplier %
dot_multiplier.description: Multiplies damage over time from Bleed, Ignite, and Corruption.

area_damage.label: Area Damage %
area_damage.description: Increases damage dealt by skills tagged as Area.

gold_find.label: Gold Find %
gold_find.description: Increases Gold dropped by defeated enemies and bosses.

item_find.label: Item Find %
item_find.description: Improves gear and gem drop chance and rarity roll odds.

double_hit.label: Double-Hit Chance %
double_hit.description: Chance for hits to echo immediately at 70% damage and re-roll on-hit effects.

life_leech.label: Life Leech %
life_leech.description: Restores a percentage of hit damage as Health, capped at 6% Max Health/s.

cast_speed.label: Cast Speed %
cast_speed.description: Reduces spell cast times and post-cast recovery delay.

mana_cost.label: Mana Cost %
mana_cost.description: Modifies Mana spent by active skills.

execute_damage.label: Execute Damage %
execute_damage.description: More damage dealt to enemies below 35% Health.

convert_physical_fire.label: Physical to Fire %
convert_physical_fire.description: Converts Physical damage bonuses and hits forward into Fire damage.

trigger_on_crit.label: Trigger on Crit
trigger_on_crit.description: Fires linked skills asynchronously when a weapon attack scores a Critical Strike.

trigger_on_damage.label: Trigger on Damage Taken
trigger_on_damage.description: Fires linked Guard skills automatically when taking a heavy hit.

projectile_count.label: Extra Projectiles
projectile_count.description: Number of additional targets hit by Projectile skills.
